rows.note: This is the colloquial all-purpose choice for someone who is partly or completely undressed.

example.english: The child was still undressed after his bath and ran around everywhere.
example.traditional: 細路仔沖完涼仲冇着衫，周圍走嚟走去。
example.jyutping: sai3 lou6 zai2 cung1 jyun4 loeng4 zung6 mou5 zoek3 saam1 zau1 wai4 zau2 lai4 zau2 heoi3

rows.note: Use this specifically when the person is partly unclothed rather than completely naked.

example.english: The model was undressed from the waist up during the photo shoot.
example.traditional: 影相嗰陣，個模特兒半裸企喺幕前。
example.jyutping: jing2 soeng2 go2 zan6 go3 mou4 dak6 ji4 bun3 lo2 kei5 hai2 mok6 cin4

rows.note: Use this specifically when the person has no clothes on at all.

example.english: They were completely undressed in bed without even a blanket.
example.traditional: 佢全裸瞓喺張床度，連被都冇蓋。
example.jyutping: keoi5 cyun4 lo2 fan3 hai2 zoeng1 cong4 dou6 lin4 pei5 dou1 mou5 goi3
